segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned over the table with two baskets and two cutting mats, preparing to begin manipulation.
The robot arm moves its left gripper towards the left basket, positioning itself to pick up a non-food item.
The robot arm grasps a black rectangular object from the left side of the table with its left gripper.
The robot arm moves the black rectangular object from the left side towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the black rectangular object into the left basket.
The robot arm retracts from the left basket and moves towards the right side of the table.
The robot arm positions its right gripper over the right basket, preparing to pick up a food item.
The robot arm grasps a yellow food item from the right cutting mat with its right gripper.
The robot arm moves the yellow food item from the right cutting mat towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the yellow food item into the right basket.
The robot arm retracts from the right basket and moves back towards the center of the table.
The robot arm positions its left gripper over the left basket, preparing to pick up another non-food item.
The robot arm grasps a black rectangular object from the left side of the table with its left gripper.
The robot arm moves the black rectangular object from the left side towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the black rectangular object into the left basket.
